# Perch Web vectors

The Site Rescue files are shared Rust and TypeScript vectors for `perch-web/v1`.

- `site-rescue.policy.json` is the reviewable source document.
- `site-rescue.canonical.json` is the stable canonical byte sequence.
- `site-rescue.policy-hash` is the lowercase SHA-256 policy identity.
- The BrowserPlan and ServerPlan files contain matched, data-only plans.

The fixture uses example origins and a sample manifest hash. Replace all bound
identity values before integration.
